limitations.title: Keep this tab open
limitations.detail: The game runs in this tab. Closing or reloading it disconnects every player until you start the session again, and a background tab the browser puts to sleep can drop them too.

limitations.title: Games are kept in this browser
limitations.detail: They and their files are stored in this browser profile only (its private file storage, OPFS): they don't follow you to another browser or computer, clearing this site's data deletes them, and there is no backup. Unless the browser grants this site persistent storage, it may also clear them when the disk is nearly full.

limitations.title: One tab hosts at a time
limitations.detail: Your games are opened by one tab of this site at a time: while a tab hosts, another one says so instead of opening them.

limitations.title: An upload cut off by a reload starts over
limitations.detail: A file still uploading when this tab closes or reloads has to be uploaded again from the start. Finished uploads, big ones included, are kept with your games.

limitations.title: Addons come from Central's registry
limitations.detail: The addons you can browse and install are the ones Central lists, downloaded through Central; another registry can't be set. An addon you have as a file still installs from the file.

limitations.title: Addons can't reach other services
limitations.detail: A browser page may only connect to the site it came from, so addons that talk to other programs or websites (for example Trilium or Obsidian notes) and actions that download a file from a link don't work here.

limitations.title: No thumbnails
limitations.detail: Images are sent to players at full size, so they load more slowly than from a GM server.

limitations.title: Log in again after a reload
limitations.detail: The host keeps your login only while this tab is open.

limitations.title: Fixed upload limits
limitations.detail: Uploads are limited to 500 MB per game for GMs and 100 MB per player, and can't be changed.
